{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vesarians''' were the inhabitants of the [[Vesari system/Legends|Vesari system]].<ref name="Planetnamia">{{JCFCite|url=posts/27848315|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2007-12-11|time=7:59 AM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170916153037/http://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-43|quote=I wouldn't get your hopes up re alien homeworlds, beyond simple stuff like the Planetnamian species getting a Planetnamia on the map or things Dan and I can account for with a relatively quick reference.|archivefile=File:JasonFry-JCFAtlasHomeworlds.png}} [[Jason Fry]], co-author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', stated his intention to create homeworlds for numerous species based on context implied from their names. The Vesari system appears to be the location of one such world.</ref> At some point before [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], a group of Vesarian students had matriculated to [[Imperial City University]]. When they were deemed dissidents by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]] under the leadership of a [[centurion]] stepped in and killed at least some of the dissidents. [[Pol Haus]], the [[Prefect/Legends|prefect]] in charge, later deemed the incident the actions of "rogue elements." The centurion was detained to await trial for the events.<ref name="CNII 7">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', Chapter 7.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Vesarians are mentioned in ''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]'', a novel written by [[Michael Reaves]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2008]]. The novel fails to indicate whether ''Vesarian'' refers to a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], a [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] demonym, or some other social group.<ref name="CNII 7" />
